MERIDIAN SERVICE YARD — LAST VEHICLE 1.15
Original geometry, materials, documentation, and generator code prepared for
A GingrSnaps Project, 2026-11-03.

CC0 1.0 Universal (CC0-1.0)
To the extent legally possible, the authors waive copyright and related rights
in this asset pack under the CC0 1.0 Universal public-domain dedication.
https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/

The geometry and muted industrial palette are authored numerically in
source-assets/yard-v115/build_props.py. Primitive construction helpers derive
from this project's existing CC0 Meridian Garage Details generator. There are
no downloaded meshes, textures, fonts, brand marks, music, or recordings in
this pack. Blender is a build tool and is not included in runtime files.

The ten v115-yard-*.glb files may be used, modified, redistributed, and sold
as part of this game or another project. Attribution is appreciated but not
required. No trademark rights are granted. Materials are provided as-is.
